text: {"reason":"Replace the second branch's supplier switch with alert-planner/immediate-expedite-review. It handled 34 costly switches at 45,000 each; alert-planner costs 35,000 and always arrives in time. The medium rows at 2.8 and 5.3 days show supplier help arriving after risk, so this should reduce the 2,165,000 cost and four stockouts without increasing either gate metric.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days) (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) (else (list 'monitor))))"}
